changelog:
🎉 What's New in FlixQuest v4.0.0

📺 All-New Android TV Experience
• Sit back and enjoy FlixQuest on your big screen with full TV remote control support
• Easy-to-use TV menu, movie catalog, search with recent history, and a built-in TV video player
• Automatically switches to TV mode when opened on a TV device

📡 Free Live TV & Sports
• Watch 24/7 live television channels across movies, news, kids, music, and entertainment
• Catch live sports and events with match schedules displayed in your local time
• Smarter live streaming with automatic reconnection if your stream drops

✨ Fresh Modern Look & Design
• Sleek, brand new look featuring clean modern icons and smooth loading animations
• New home screen feeds: Trending, Top 10 This Week, New Releases, and Upcoming
• Brand new details pages with trailers, full cast & crew, "More Like This" recommendations, and user reviews
• Interactive season and episode picker with episode descriptions and preview images
• Powerful new filters by genre, release year, streaming provider, or try your luck with Random Discovery

📥 Download & Watch Offline
• Save full movies and TV episodes directly to your device to watch on planes, road trips, or without Wi-Fi
• Subtitles are automatically saved and bundled with your downloads
• Brand new Downloads tab to easily manage and play your saved videos

🎬 Upgraded Video Player with Swipe Gestures
• Swipe up/down on the right side of the screen to change volume 🔊
• Swipe up/down on the left side of the screen to change brightness ☀️
• Swipe left/right in the center to quickly scrub forward or backward ⏩
• Preview thumbnail frames while dragging the progress bar 🖼
• Quick episode switcher right inside the player so you don't have to leave full screen 📺
• Change video quality and switch audio tracks with ease ⚙️

💬 Smarter Subtitles & File Uploads
• Automatically finds multi-language subtitles for any movie or show 🔍
• Upload your own subtitle files (.srt / .vtt) directly from your device 📂
• Customize subtitle text size, font color, and background box in settings 🎨

🌈 Ambient Glow & Holiday Themes
• Ambient Mode: The app now glows with matching colors based on the movie or show artwork you're viewing ✨

⚠️ The new version uses a brand new backend, so old user accounts are not transferred to the new one. You're going to have to sign up again. Sorry for the inconvenience.
